prompt:
Our DevOps team needs a point-in-time network audit of this server. We need to know: (1) which ports are currently open and listening, (2) all active ESTABLISHED connections, and (3) overall network-level statistics (packets, segments, errors, etc.).

Please gather all three pieces of information using the available tooling in this workspace and compile everything into a single file called `network_audit_report.json`. The report should be machine-readable and clearly separate the three categories of data. The values must come from actually running the diagnostics — do not make up or estimate any numbers.
